A '''government''' of the [[Ishi Tib]] on the [[planet]] [[Tibrin]] was active during the [[Imperial Era]]. It was led by a high-ranking spiritual leader known as the [[Kalikeedan]] and including another high-ranking official known as the [[Mariod]]. The Ishi Tib [[Govi]] served as the Mariod during the [[Galactic Civil War]], and the planet maintained a [[Ishi Tib fleet|fleet]] that consisted of at least three [[Marsheem-class heavy cruiser|''Marsheem''-class heavy cruisers]]. Following a [[mission to Tibrin]] undertaken by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] some time after the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Ishi Tib joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire]], which had a presence on Tibrin.<ref name="SWA 5" />
